text:
maria: Quick heads-up: scheduling a short maintenance window for APAC edge tonight 02:30-03:15 SGT to address intermittent NIC driver packet drops on a small cohort. This will be a rolling reboot of 5 hosts (no pool-wide drain). Expect brief 95th pct latency blips while tasks backfill.

jon: Which racks/hosts are targeted? can we avoid any pinned capacity?

maria: Targets: rack-apac-07:[host5,host6] and rack-apac-09:[host1,host2,host3]. I checked reservations: no dedicated customers pinned here. We'll use spot pools for backfill where possible.

sam: How are we ensuring KV/prefix cache isn't cold for >30m like last time?

maria: Plan: pre-seed KV cache + stagger reboots by host to let caches warm. Steps: 1) spin 3 warmbackfill GPUs 30m prior, 2) run kvseed from warm-host-01 -> each target 15m pre, 3) cordon -> restart nic/driver -> run health checks -> uncordon. Script we run: 

```
# pre-seed and restart flow
./infra/tools/ensure-standby --count 3 --type g4dn
for h in host5 host6 host1 host2 host3; do
  ./infra/tools/kvseed --from warm-host-01 --to $h &
  sleep 90  # stagger seeds
  ./infra/tools/cordon $h && ./infra/tools/restart-nic $h
  ./infra/tools/check-host-health $h || ./infra/tools/rollback $h
done
```

kevin: Cost estimate for standby GPUs? ops budget sign-off?

maria: We expect ~3 extra g4dn for ~1h => ~USD 90. Finance OK'ed emergency buffer for this window.

jon: Canary? QA? post to status?

deploy-bot: Canary pipelines queued for canary-cohort-2 at 02:10 SGT

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: maintenance/apac-edge/2026-03-21-02:30. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/apac-edge-nic-restart. On-call: jon (networking).

maria: I'll post a short status advisory: "Possible short-lived latency spikes in APAC edge during maintenance" — priya in product will review.

sam: I'll monitor KV hit ratio and request routing. If we see >5% 5xx or 95th token latency >2x baseline, we abort.

kevin: Standby GPUs are up and warm; cost meter watching.

jon: QA canary passed at 02:15. Good to proceed.

maria: Triggering at 02:30. Postmortem notes will be added here after. :rocket:
